dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Meet Cupcake, a sweet girl who is currently feeling quite overwhelmed in the care center environment. At the shelter, she expresses her nerves by shaking or looking for cozy places to hide, but her true potential shines through when she is around her housemate, who gives her a massive boost of confidence. While Cupcake is hesitant during solo socialization sessions right now, she will gently accept treats in her kennel once she feels safe. With a patient person, Cupcake will be able to decompress and let her affectionate, social nature come forward at her own pace.
dog.name: Cupcake
